functions.name: batch-delete-members

memberId.description: Account member ID, available from list-group-members or member reads.

anyOf.description: Select a member by account member ID.

email.description: Email identifying the account member to delete.

anyOf.description: Select a member by email address.

items.description: One account member selected by ID or email address.

members.description: Member records to delete, each selected by one account-scoped identifier or email.

FunctionInput_cyberimpact_batchdeletemem.description: Submit one asynchronous batch deleting up to 100 member records.

id.description: Batch ID to inspect with get-batch.

status.description: Current provider batch state; acceptance does not prove deletion.

FunctionOutput_cyberimpact_batchdeleteme.description: Batch submission receipt, not individual deletion outcomes.

tags.instructions: Use only when member records should be deleted, not merely unsubscribed or removed from a group. Maximum 100 targets. Use `batch-unsubscribe-members` for communication opt-out instead. Save the returned id and call `get-batch` for actual completion and partial failures. No undo is promised.

functions.name: batch-unsubscribe-members
functions.description: Submit up to 100 members for asynchronous unsubscription by member ID or email address. Returns a batch receipt rather than completed unsubscriptions.

memberId.description: Account-scoped member ID, available from list-group-members or member reads.

anyOf.description: Select a member by account-scoped member ID.

email.description: Email identifying the member in the connected account.

anyOf.description: Select a member by email address.

items.description: Exactly one member ID or email selector.

members.description: Members to unsubscribe, each selected by exactly one account member ID or email.

FunctionInput_cyberimpact_batchunsubscri.description: Submit one asynchronous account-level unsubscription batch.

status.description: Provider processing state; NEW or PROCESSING is not completed unsubscription.

FunctionOutput_cyberimpact_batchunsubscr.description: Batch submission receipt, not individual unsubscription outcomes.

tags.instructions: Use for multiple account-level unsubscriptions, not deletion or removal from one group. Maximum 100 targets. Supply a member ID or email for each target. Save the returned id and use `get-batch` for completion and partial failures. Do not resubmit while processing.

functions.name: batch-upsert-members
functions.description: Submit up to 100 members for asynchronous creation or update by email, optionally adding them to groups. Returns a batch receipt, not a guarantee that member changes have completed.

note.description: Member note as ordinary text; null clears, omission or empty text retains existing data.

email.description: Member email and account-scoped match key; cannot be cleared.

gender.description: Provider gender value; null clears, omission or empty text retains existing data.

company.description: Company name; null clears, omission or empty text retains existing data.

country.description: Country value, normally a two-letter country code; null clears, omission or empty text retains existing data.

language.description: Member language value, such as en_ca or fr_ca; null clears, omission or empty text retains existing data.

lastName.description: Family name; null clears, omission or empty text retains existing data.

birthdate.description: Birth calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form; null clears and omission retains existing data.

firstName.description: Given name; null clears, omission or empty text retains existing data.

postalCode.description: Postal code; null clears, omission or empty text retains existing data.

consentDate.description: Individual consent calendar date; null requests clearing, omission lets provider batch-default rules apply.

consentProof.description: Individual consent evidence; null clears, omission lets provider batch-default rules apply.

customFields.description: Custom-field ID to typed scalar value. Omitted keys are retained; null clears a key. Dates remain date strings. An empty map changes no keys.

anyOf.description: Text custom-field value, including date strings.

additionalProperties.description: Typed scalar custom-field value; null clears the key.

items.description: Member information to create or update by email.

members.description: Members matched by email within the connected account; duplicate email matches within the request are rejected.

groupIds.description: Account group IDs to add all submitted members to; omission or an empty array adds no groups and removes none.

items.description: Account group ID as a decimal string.

relationType.description: Relationship category required by Cyberimpact for this member batch.

defaultConsentDate.description: Default consent calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD, used by the provider where an individual consent date is not supplied.

defaultConsentProof.description: Default consent evidence text; omitted means no batch-level proof is supplied.

FunctionInput_cyberimpact_batchupsertmem.description: One asynchronous batch of up to 100 member creations or updates, with optional additive group membership and consent defaults.

id.description: Account-scoped batch ID to pass to get-batch.

status.description: Provider batch state, normally NEW, PROCESSING, or COMPLETED; acceptance is not completion.

FunctionOutput_cyberimpact_batchupsertme.description: Batch submission receipt only; member processing may still be pending or may partially fail.

tags.instructions: Use for multiple member creations or updates matched by email. Existing group memberships are retained. Null clears a supported optional field; omitted or empty text retains existing data. Maximum 100 members. Use `list-groups` to obtain group IDs. Save the returned id and use `get-batch` to inspect completion and partial failures; do not resubmit merely because status is NEW or PROCESSING.

functions.name: create-api-token
functions.description: Create an API token associated with the connected account and return its secret, identifier, and provider-supplied expiration information.

FunctionInput_cyberimpact_createapitoken.description: No input is needed to create an API token for the connected account.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the newly created API token, used to revoke it; not the authentication secret.

token.description: Secret credential used to authenticate API requests. Handle as sensitive data and do not expose in ordinary logs or messages.

expiration.description: Provider-supplied expiration text, preserved exactly when present. The provider example is 2032-01-01 12:34:56, but its timezone is undocumented; this is not a normalized UTC instant. Omitted if the provider supplies no expiration.

FunctionOutput_cyberimpact_createapitoke.description: The newly created API token identifier, secret credential, and optional provider-supplied expiration text.

tags.instructions: Use this tool to create an additional API credential for the connected account. No input is needed. Treat the returned token as a secret and store its id securely for later revocation with `delete-api-token`. The expiration text has no documented timezone; do not interpret it as UTC. Creating a token does not configure or replace the integration's connection. Do not blindly retry an uncertain result: another token may have been created.

functions.name: create-group
functions.description: Create a new static group with an explicit name and public/private choice.

FunctionInput_cyberimpact_creategroup.description: Name and explicit visibility of the static group to create.

isDynamic.description: Whether the group is dynamic; newly created groups are documented as static.

FunctionOutput_cyberimpact_creategroup.description: Created group with its account-scoped ID and available provider-returned attributes.

tags.instructions: Use to create a static group. Choose visibility explicitly. Use `update-group` to change an existing group. The returned id can be used with `list-group-members` or `create-mailing`.

functions.name: create-mailing
functions.description: Create an email mailing scheduled to start sending to specified groups. This is not draft creation: successful submission can lead to email being sent at the scheduled time.

replyTo.description: Reply address; omission lets the provider apply its default.

subject.description: Email subject as ordinary Unicode text.

bodyHtml.description: HTML email body as ordinary text; at least one nonempty HTML or plain-text body is required.

bodyText.description: Plain-text email body; at least one nonempty HTML or plain-text body is required.

fromName.description: Sender display name; omission uses provider behavior.

items.description: Account group ID.

groupIds.description: Account group IDs whose members should receive the mailing. Provider recipient deduplication and eligibility rules apply.

language.description: Mailing language, English Canada or French Canada.

fromEmail.description: Sender email already validated in this account; omitted means use provider behavior.

googleAnalytics.description: Whether to enable Google Analytics tracking; omission leaves the provider default unchanged.

sendAtLocalTime.description: Calendar date and wall-clock time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss on Cyberimpact's scheduling clock, without offset. This is not a UTC instant; confirm the account clock before scheduling. Fractional seconds are not accepted.

mailingStatistics.description: Detailed statistics or anonymized click/open statistics; defaults to detailed.

updateProfileFormId.description: Account update-profile form ID to include at the bottom, when desired.

googleAnalyticsCampaign.description: Google Analytics campaign text; omitted means no explicit campaign is supplied.

FunctionInput_cyberimpact_createmailing.description: Content, recipient groups, sender options, and wall-clock send time for a scheduled mailing.

status.description: Provider-returned mailing state; does not establish recipient delivery.

scheduledLocalTime.description: Provider scheduling-clock value with space normalized to T, retaining fractional digits and no invented offset; null means no scheduled value was returned.

FunctionOutput_cyberimpact_createmailing.description: Created mailing identity and provider-returned scheduling details, not a delivery confirmation.

tags.instructions: Get recipient group IDs from `list-groups`. Supply content, language, and a send time on Cyberimpact's scheduling clock; confirm that clock's timezone in the account because the API does not document it. Sender email, if supplied, must already be validated in the account. The result establishes creation, not recipient delivery. Use `get-mailing` for status and statistics, or `delete-mailing` to remove an unsent mailing. Do not blindly retry creation.

gender.description: Stored provider gender code, including empty when unset.

functions.name: create-template

FunctionInput_cyberimpact_createtemplate.description: New reusable template title and at least one ordinary-text body representation.

bodyText.description: Plain-text body; at least one body must be supplied. Whitespace and Unicode are preserved.

updatedOn.description: Provider update date-time text; timezone unspecified.

FunctionOutput_cyberimpact_createtemplat.description: Provider-stored representation of the newly created reusable template.

tags.instructions: Supply a title and at least one body as ordinary text. This creates a template but sends no mailing. Use `update-template` to replace an existing template and `get-template` to inspect saved content.

functions.name: delete-api-token
functions.description: Permanently revoke an API token so that it can no longer authenticate API requests.

tokenId.description: Opaque identifier of the API token to revoke, returned as id by create-api-token. Supply the identifier, not the authentication secret.

FunctionInput_cyberimpact_deleteapitoken.description: The API token identifier to permanently revoke.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the API token whose revocation was acknowledged.

revoked.description: True when the provider successfully acknowledged permanent revocation; the token can no longer authenticate API requests.

FunctionOutput_cyberimpact_deleteapitoke.description: Acknowledgment that the specified API token was permanently revoked.

tags.instructions: Use this tool to permanently invalidate a known API credential. Supply its identifier, not its secret; `create-api-token` returns that identifier as id. Revocation cannot be undone. Revoking a token that authenticates this integration can prevent subsequent API calls, so ensure a separate usable credential is available when appropriate. Use `create-api-token` to issue a replacement credential, not to restore a revoked one.

functions.name: delete-group

functions.name: delete-member

functions.name: delete-template

functions.name: get-batch
functions.description: Get a submitted member batch's current processing state and any provider-reported successes and errors.

batchId.description: Account-scoped batch ID returned by a batch submission tool.

FunctionInput_cyberimpact_getbatch.description: Identify the submitted member batch to inspect.

type.description: Provider batch type, such as addMembers, unsubscribe, or deleteMembers.

result.description: Provider outcomes; null means no result yet, and absent fields remain absent rather than implying zero outcomes.

errors.description: Provider-reported invalid rows or failed items; no local per-item code is invented.

target.description: Provider error id normalized to a string; may be a member ID or email and is not assumed to be a row index.

message.description: Provider description of this item's failure; correct the named member data or access before a selective retry.

items.description: One provider-reported failed item and its available target and explanation.

successes.description: Provider-reported successful member identifiers; values remain opaque and are not inferred from request order.

items.description: An opaque successful member identifier reported by the provider.

status.description: Provider processing state, normally NEW, PROCESSING, or COMPLETED; completion can include failures.

FunctionOutput_cyberimpact_getbatch.description: Current batch processing state and available provider-reported outcomes, without the submitted member payload.

tags.instructions: Use the id returned by a Batch member tool. NEW or PROCESSING means work is still pending; check again later rather than resubmitting. COMPLETED may include both successes and errors. This performs one status read and does not wait for completion.
